master_skills.name: core-synergy-skill
master_skills.title_zh: core-synergy-skill (底層協同與工程門禁全集)
master_skills.description_zh: 本技能定義 Antigravity 與 OpenCode 雙 Agent 協同架構、多模型分工策略、grill-with-docs 領域模型審核、kb-retriever 本地知識庫漸進式檢索與自動化二方代碼門禁。
master_skills.description_en: Defines Antigravity & OpenCode dual-agent architecture, multi-model delegation, domain grilling, kb-retriever progressive knowledge base search, and automated code review gate.

principles.title_zh: 雙主 Agent (Antigravity × OpenCode) 與多 LLM 戰隊分工原理
principles.desc_zh: Antigravity 作為「主 Agent」，為內嵌的各個 LLM 派發工作。具體由 Gemini (Pro/Flash) 負責系統架構規劃與邏輯測試；Claude 專責 UI/UX 與美感建立（且 Claude 僅在「初次建立視覺」時啟用一次，後續微調與修復一律禁用以保護配額）。在需要時（如遇到問題或驗證代碼），Antigravity 會自主呼叫 OpenCode 進行「雙主 Agent 協同」。OpenCode 同樣能調度 LLM 作為子 Agent，當執行特定任務（如搜尋 20 個檔案並修改）時，OpenCode 會開啟全新的獨立 Subagent 上下文視窗處理，大幅降低整個專案開發過程中的總 Token 消耗！
principles.desc_en: Antigravity acts as the primary leader agent, assigning work to embedded LLM subagents. Gemini models handle system architecture and logic testing. Claude is dedicated to initial UI/UX aesthetic creation (strictly enabled ONLY once during initial creation to conserve quota). When verification or error resolution is needed, Antigravity autonomously invokes OpenCode for dual-leader synergy. OpenCode also dispatches LLM subagents in isolated subagent context windows for multi-file operations (e.g., searching and editing 20 files), dramatically reducing overall token consumption across project development!

principles.title_zh: 工作流程：grill-with-docs 領域模型與架構對齊機制
principles.title_en: Workflow: grill-with-docs Domain Modeling & Architecture Alignment
principles.desc_zh: 當輸入包含「架構」、「規劃」、「設計」等意圖關鍵字時，系統自動啟動需求對齊程序。透過結構化問答釐清領域模型 (Domain Modeling) 與系統邊界，確定無誤後生成 `.antigravity/tasks/task-xxx.md` 任務看板檔，再交由 OpenCode 進行非互動式執行與驗證。
principles.desc_en: When keywords like 'architecture' or 'planning' are detected, system initiates domain grilling to clarify boundaries and outputs task board files (.antigravity/tasks/*.md) for OpenCode execution.
principles.svg_zh:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1020 580" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="grill-with-docs 領域模型與架構對齊決策流程圖">
  <defs>
    <style>
      svg {
        --paper: #f8fafc; --ink: #0f172a; --muted: #475569; --soft: #64748b;
        --accent: #eb6c36; --accent-tint: rgba(235,108,54,0.08);
        --link: #0284c7; --link-tint: rgba(2,132,199,0.08);
        --emerald: #059669; --emerald-tint: rgba(5,150,105,0.08);
        --sans: 'Geist', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;

      }
    </style>
    <pattern id="dots-proc" width="22" height="22" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <circle cx="2" cy="2" r="0.9" fill="rgba(15,23,42,0.08)"/>
    </pattern>
    <marker id="fl-arr-muted" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="5" refX="6" refY="2.5" orient="auto">
      <polygon points="0 0, 7 2.5, 0 5" fill="#64748b"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="fl-arr-accent" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="5" refX="6" refY="2.5" orient="auto">
      <polygon points="0 0, 7 2.5, 0 5" fill="#eb6c36"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="fl-arr-link" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="5" refX="6" refY="2.5" orient="auto">
      <polygon points="0 0, 7 2.5, 0 5" fill="#0284c7"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="fl-arr-emerald" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="5" refX="6" refY="2.5" orient="auto">
      <polygon points="0 0, 7 2.5, 0 5" fill="#059669"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" rx="14"/>
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="url(#dots-proc)" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- ZONE: Grilling Safety Guard Zone (x: 230, y: 160, w: 500, h: 205) -->
  <rect x="230" y="160" width="500" height="205" rx="12" fill="rgba(235,108,54,0.02)" stroke="rgba(235,108,54,0.3)" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
  <rect x="245" y="151" width="180" height="18" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#eb6c36" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <text x="335" y="164" fill="#eb6c36" font-size="8.5" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle">🍖 需求對齊與架構防禦圈</text>

  <!-- FLOW ARROWS -->
  <!-- Step 1 to Gate -->
  <line x1="210" y1="70" x2="350" y2="70" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#fl-arr-link)"/>
  
  <!-- Gate to Bypass (Top Right) -->
  <line x1="570" y1="70" x2="750" y2="70" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4,3" marker-end="url(#fl-arr-muted)"/>
  <rect x="615" y="58" width="80" height="15" rx="3" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <text x="655" y="69" fill="#64748b" font-size="8" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle">簡易指令</text>

  <!-- Gate down to Grill (Clean arrow with right-aligned label, no collision) -->
  <line x1="460" y1="102" x2="460" y2="182" stroke="#eb6c36" stroke-width="1.8" marker-end="url(#fl-arr-accent)"/>
  <rect x="475" y="130" width="125" height="18" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#eb6c36" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <text x="537" y="142" fill="#eb6c36" font-size="8.5" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle">觸發架構關鍵字 ↓</text>

  <!-- Grill down to Diamond -->
  <line x1="460" y1="238" x2="460" y2="265" stroke="#eb6c36" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#fl-arr-accent)"/>

  <!-- Decision Loop: Diamond (Left) -> Back up to Grill -->
  <path d="M 370,300 H 280 V 210 H 340" fill="none" stroke="#eb6c36" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-dasharray="4,3" marker-end="url(#fl-arr-accent)"/>
  <rect x="220" y="245" width="115" height="16" rx="3" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#fdba74" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <text x="277" y="256" fill="#c2410c" font-size="8" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle">否 (NO) · 繼續提問對齊</text>

  <!-- Decision Diamond (Bottom) -> Step 3 (ADR) -->
  <line x1="460" y1="336" x2="460" y2="380" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="1.8" marker-end="url(#fl-arr-emerald)"/>
  <rect x="475" y="348" width="95" height="16" rx="3" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#6ee7b7" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <text x="522" y="359" fill="#059669" font-size="8.5" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle">是 (YES) · 鎖定邊界</text>

  <!-- Step 3 (ADR) down to Step 4 (OpenCode) -->
  <line x1="460" y1="436" x2="460" y2="470" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="1.8" marker-end="url(#fl-arr-emerald)"/>

  <!-- Step 4 (OpenCode) right to Step 5 (Done) -->
  <line x1="570" y1="502" x2="720" y2="502" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="1.8" marker-end="url(#fl-arr-emerald)"/>

  <!-- Bypass line directly to OpenCode -->
  <path d="M 850,98 V 470" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4,3" marker-end="url(#fl-arr-muted)"/>


  <!-- 1. START NODE -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 42)">
    <rect width="170" height="56" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="8" y="8" width="30" height="12" rx="3" fill="rgba(2,132,199,0.12)"/>
    <text x="23" y="17" fill="#0284c7" font-size="7" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle">START</text>
    <text x="85" y="28" fill="#0f172a" font-size="11.5" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle">1. 使用者輸入需求</text>
    <text x="85" y="44" fill="#0284c7" font-size="8.5" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle">「架構 / 規劃 / 設計」</text>
  </g>

  <!-- GATE: Decision Interceptor -->
  <g transform="translate(350, 38)">
    <rect width="220" height="64" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="8" y="8" width="32" height="12" rx="3" fill="#475569"/>
    <text x="24" y="17" fill="#ffffff" font-size="7" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle">GATE</text>
    <text x="110" y="30" fill="#0f172a" font-size="12" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle">智慧意圖攔截</text>
    <text x="110" y="48" fill="#64748b" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">判斷是否需要嚴謹對齊？</text>
  </g>

  <!-- BYPASS NODE -->
  <g transform="translate(750, 42)">
    <rect width="200" height="56" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
    <text x="100" y="28" fill="#64748b" font-size="11" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle">直通極速模式 (Bypass)</text>
    <text x="100" y="44" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="8.5" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" text-anchor="middle">「直接做/寫code/fix bug」</text>
  </g>

  <!-- 2. GRILL NODE (Focal Coral) -->
  <g transform="translate(340, 182)">
    <rect width="240" height="56" rx="8" fill="rgba(235,108,54,0.08)" stroke="#eb6c36" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="8" y="8" width="34" height="12" rx="3" fill="#eb6c36"/>
    <text x="25" y="17" fill="#ffffff" font-size="7" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle">GRILL</text>
    <text x="120" y="28" fill="#0f172a" font-size="12" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle">2. 3-5 輪深度領域詰問</text>
    <text x="120" y="44" fill="#c2410c" font-size="8.5" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle">主動排查邊界死角與資料流</text>
  </g>

  <!-- DECISION DIAMOND -->
  <g transform="translate(460, 300)">
    <polygon points="0,-35 90,0 0,35 -90,0" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#eb6c36" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="0" y="-4" fill="#0f172a" font-size="10.5" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle">需求與邊界</text>
    <text x="0" y="12" fill="#0f172a" font-size="10.5" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle">是否已釐清？</text>
  </g>

  <!-- 3. ADR & TASK BOARDS -->
  <g transform="translate(340, 380)">
    <rect width="240" height="56" rx="8" fill="rgba(2,132,199,0.06)" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="8" y="8" width="30" height="12" rx="3" fill="#0284c7"/>
    <text x="23" y="17" fill="#ffffff" font-size="7" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle">DOCS</text>
    <text x="120" y="28" fill="#0f172a" font-size="12" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle">3. 產出 ADR 與 Task 看板檔</text>

  </g>

  <!-- 4. OPENCODE EXECUTION -->

    <rect x="8" y="8" width="36" height="12" rx="3" fill="#059669"/>
    <text x="26" y="17" fill="#ffffff" font-size="7" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle">CODE</text>
    <text x="115" y="32" fill="#0f172a" font-size="12.5" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle">4. OpenCode 無人值守執行</text>
    <text x="115" y="50" fill="#059669" font-size="8.5" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle">非互動式實作 · 自動化測試</text>
  </g>

  <!-- 5. DONE & DELIVER -->
  <g transform="translate(720, 470)">
    <rect width="240" height="64" rx="8" fill="rgba(5,150,105,0.12)" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>

  </g>
</svg>

principles.title_zh: 📚 kb-retriever 本地知識庫分層索引與低 Context 漸進檢索機制
principles.title_en: 📚 kb-retriever Hierarchical Indexing & Low-Context Progressive Retrieval
principles.desc_zh:
kb-retriever 是高效探索本機知識庫（如 `knowledge/` 或指定文檔目錄）的探針演算法，解決巨型文檔擠爆 Context Window 的痛點：
1. 分层索引導航 (data_structure.md Tree)：從根目錄與子目錄的 `data_structure.md` 索引檔開始閱讀，先了解領域地圖與目錄用途，不盲目讀取整份檔案。
2. 先學習再處理原則 (Learn-Before-Process)：遇到 PDF/Excel 等二進位文檔時，強制先讀取解構指南（pdftotext, pdfplumber, pandas），將結構化提取完成後才進行文字檢索。
3. 5 輪上限漸進搜尋 (5-Round Bounded Search)：結合 `grep` 關鍵字搜尋與局部視窗讀取 (Windowed Read)，最多 5 輪收斂候選集合，回答時強制附帶檔案相對路徑與段落出處標註 (Source Attribution)。
principles.desc_en:
kb-retriever is a precision retrieval algorithm for local knowledge bases (e.g. `knowledge/` directory), preventing LLM context window overflow:
1. Hierarchical Index Tree Navigation: Reads `data_structure.md` index files at root and subdirectories to understand domain maps before inspecting file contents.
2. Learn-Before-Process Rule: Enforces reading extraction references (pdftotext, pdfplumber, pandas) before processing binary PDF/Excel documents.
3. 5-Round Bounded Search: Combines `grep` and windowed line reads within a strict 5-round limit, always citing relative file paths and line ranges in final answers.

principles.title_zh: 🛡️ Matt Pocock 現代嚴謹軟體工程方法論：何時用？怎麼用？（完整實戰指南）
principles.title_en: 🛡️ Matt Pocock Modern Software Engineering Suite: When & How to Use (Complete Practical Guide)
principles.desc_zh:
Matt Pocock 頂級工程技能套件（8 大核心技能）旨在消除 AI 寫 code 時常犯的「幻覺、盲目猜測、破壞既有架構與假陽性測試」，依據軟體開發生命週期分為四大階段：

一、 🎯 需求釐清與架構決策（寫 Code 前）
1. 🍖 grill-with-docs / grill-me
   • 何時用：當收到模糊的新功能需求、重大架構變更、或想要「先想清楚再動手」時。
   • 怎麼用：輸入「開 grill」、「grill me」或「/grill-with-docs」。Agent 會扮演嚴格架構師主動進行 3-5 輪深度詰問，釐清邊界條件並產出 ADR (Architecture Decision Record) 架構決策記錄，杜絕邊做邊改。
2. 📐 domain-modeling (領域建模)
   • 何時用：新專案啟動、跨模組整合或業務術語混亂時。
   • 怎麼用：要求 Agent 建立領域模型，會在專案根目錄產出 `CONTEXT.md`，統一定義實體 (Entities)、值物件 (Value Objects) 與業務規則，防止模型名詞歧義。

二、 🧪 測試驅動開發與代碼實作（寫 Code 時）
3. 🔴🟢 tdd (Test-Driven Development)
   • 何時用：開發任何新 API、新邏輯函數、或修復特定 Bug 時（極力推薦日常預設使用）。
   • 怎麼用：遵循「紅燈 ➜ 綠燈 ➜ 重構」三部曲。第一步先撰寫失敗的單元測試（紅燈），第二步用最少代碼讓測試通過（綠燈），第三步進行架構優化（重構）。杜絕寫出無法測試或自我催眠的代碼。
4. 🏗️ codebase-design & improve-codebase-architecture
   • 何時用：程式庫變得臃腫、代碼耦合度高、或新增功能容易牽一髮動全身時。
   • 怎麼用：進行單一職責與依賴反轉重構，自動分離業務邏輯與 I/O 邊界，讓系統具備高可擴展性。

三、 🔬 科學化排查與除錯（出 Bug 時）
5. 🔍 diagnosing-bugs (根因排查診斷)
   • 何時用：遇到罕見 Bug、假陰性問題、或無法重現的靈異現象時。
   • 怎麼用：嚴禁盲目猜測修改！Agent 會強制執行「四步診斷法」：1. 寫出最小重現腳本 (Reproduction Case) ➜ 2. 建立斷言 ➜ 3. 收集運行時指標 ➜ 4. 鎖定根因並修復。

四、 🛡️ 代碼審查與需求拆解（交付前）
6. 🕵️ code-review (二方代碼審查門禁)
   • 何時用：功能開發完成準備 Commit、或發起 Pull Request 前。
   • 怎麼用：由獨立的 Reviewer Agent 檢查程式碼異味 (Code Smells)、安全性漏洞 (OWASP)、效能瓶頸與型別完整性，提供客觀評分與修復建議。
7. 📋 to-spec / to-tickets / triage (規格化與任務拆解)
   • 何時用：使用者丟下一長串自然語言需求，需要拆解成可執行的工程里程碑時。
   • 怎麼用：自動將需求轉換為 Markdown 清單與精確的 GitHub/Linear Issue Tickets，標註前後依賴關係。
principles.desc_en:
The Matt Pocock Elite Engineering Suite eliminates AI coding hallucinations, guessing, and brittle refactors through 4 structured lifecycle phases:

1. 🎯 Requirements & Architecture Alignment (Before Coding)
   • grill-with-docs / grill-me: Use when requirements are underspecified or architectural plans need validation. Trigger with 'grill me' to initiate 3-5 rounds of architectural interrogation and produce ADRs.
   • domain-modeling: Use for new modules or complex domains. Generates `CONTEXT.md` defining ubiquitous language, Entities, and Value Objects.

2. 🧪 Test-Driven Development & Implementation (While Coding)
   • tdd: Use for all new features and bug fixes. Follows RED (failing test) -> GREEN (minimal implementation) -> REFACTOR.
   • codebase-design: Use when decoupling legacy monoliths or separating business logic from I/O boundaries.

3. 🔬 Scientific Root-Cause Debugging (When Fixing Bugs)
   • diagnosing-bugs: Use when encountering rare or flaky bugs. Enforces minimal reproduction scripts and mechanical assertions before touching code.

4. 🛡️ Code Review & Task Decomposition (Before Delivery)
   • code-review: Use before committing or PR creation. Runs automated checks for code smells, OWASP security, and performance.
   • to-spec / to-tickets / triage: Decomposes natural language requests into atomic, dependency-aware implementation tickets.

principles.title_zh: 🛡️ Nutlope Hallmark 反 AI 模板化防禦機制 (Anti-Slop Defense Protocol)
principles.title_en: 🛡️ Nutlope Hallmark Anti-AI Slop Defense Protocol
principles.desc_zh:
Nutlope Hallmark 是防止生成式 AI 產出同質化、平庸藍灰模板 (Slop UI) 的強效防禦體系。其包含三大核心支柱：
1. 20 主題氣質輪替 (Theme Catalog)：打破預設 AI 藍白介面，隨機或依語境套用 20 種獨特美學氣質（如古雅明朝、賽博終端、暗黑便當盒等）。
2. 8-State 組件寫滿 (8-State Completeness)：強制所有 UI 組件必須實作 Default、Hover、Active、Focus、Loading、Success、Error、Disabled 完整 8 種狀態，防止互動空洞。
3. Pre-emit 6 軸自我評分 (6-Axis Self-Scoring)：在輸出程式碼前，針對層次感、對比度、留白、觸感細節、效能與響應式進行 6 軸打分，確保最高 Production 品質。
principles.desc_en:
Nutlope Hallmark is a robust defense framework against bland, repetitive AI-generated interfaces (Slop UI). Built on 3 core pillars:
1. 20 Aesthetic Theme Catalog: Replaces generic AI blue/grey themes with 20 distinct visual signatures (e.g., Editorial Serif, Cyber Terminal, Bento Dark Lux).
2. 8-State Component Completeness: Enforces full implementation of Default, Hover, Active, Focus, Loading, Success, Error, and Disabled states on all interactive controls.
3. Pre-emit 6-Axis Self-Scoring: Evaluates hierarchy, contrast, whitespace, tactile details, 60fps performance, and responsiveness before emitting production code.

principles.title_en: 🎨 web-design-engineer 5-Dial Design Read & 25 Anchored Style Recipes
principles.desc_zh:
web-design-engineer 是極致前端設計工程師的設計思維體系，核心包含三大部分：
1. 5-Dial 視覺旋鈕校準 (Design Read)：在撰寫程式碼前，先針對「視覺變異度 (Variance)」、「動效強度 (Motion)」、「資訊密度 (Density)」、「資產依賴 (Asset Dependence)」與「品牌忠誠度 (Brand Fidelity)」進行 1-10 旋鈕定位，決策佈局方向。
2. 25 品牌錨定風格配方 (25 Style Recipes)：涵蓋 Linear 極致黑、Stripe Press 印藝、Aesop 藥劑師哲學、Bloomberg 交易終端、Monocle 雜誌刊物、MUJI 原研哉極簡、Apple HIG 等 25 種業界大師級色彩、字體配對與 DNA 簽名動作 (Signature Moves)。
3. 品牌資產至上法則 (Asset > Spec)：嚴禁使用偽手繪或替代品取代真實品牌 Logo 與產品照。強調「Logo 非談判項目，真實產品照優於 Hex 色票」，絕不產出同質化的 AI 藍紫漸層模板！
principles.desc_en:
web-design-engineer elevates AI generated frontends with design engineer principles:
1. 5-Dial Design Read Calibration: Calibrates Visual Variance, Motion Intensity, Information Density, Asset Dependence, and Brand Fidelity (1-10 dials) before coding.
2. 25 Anchored Style Recipes: Includes Linear Dark, Stripe Press Typography, Aesop Apothecary, Bloomberg Terminal, Monocle Magazine, MUJI Kenya Hara, and Apple HIG, each with palette, fonts, and signature moves.
3. Brand Asset Protocol (Asset > Spec): Enforces real logos and product imagery over generic hex codes. Forbids synthetic AI blue gradients or CSS silhouettes in brand work.

principles.title_zh: 🖼️ Editorial Vision Studio AI 視覺總監與跨模型決策流水線
principles.title_en: 🖼️ Editorial Vision Studio AI Creative Director & Cross-Model Pipeline
principles.desc_zh:
Editorial Vision Studio 是專為 AI 圖像生成、視覺概念與社論級排版設計打造的「AI 視覺總監決策引擎」。核心架構採「固定決策大腦 + 可插拔模型適配器」：
1. 哲學核心 (Do not decorate. Always interpret)：絕不單純添加無意義的裝飾元素，而是深度詮釋主體與氛圍，並具備 Panter-style 低對比/灰色照片修復補償機制。
2. 5 階決策流水線 (Decision Engine)：包含意圖分析 (Intent) ➜ 視覺分析 (Analyzer) ➜ 視覺語言 (Visual Lang: Swiss, Kinfolk, MUJI, Brutalist, POPEYE) ➜ 空間規劃 (Planner) ➜ 產出純視覺邏輯規範 EditorialSpec（零語法污染）。
3. 跨模型一鍵適配 (Model Adapters)：同一份 EditorialSpec 可無縫派發給 GPT Image (DALL-E 3)、Flux.1 (Pro/Dev) 或 Ideogram 2.0 專用適配器編譯出最佳提示詞，切換模型時完美保留 100% 相同創意方向！
principles.desc_en:
Editorial Vision Studio serves as the AI Creative Director for high-end visual generation, editorial layouts, and brand assets:
1. Philosophy (Do not decorate. Always interpret): Refuses shallow decoration in favor of deep conceptual interpretation, featuring Panter-style low-contrast recovery.
2. 5-Step Decision Engine: Intent Engine ➜ Visual Analyzer ➜ Visual Language (Swiss, Kinfolk, MUJI, Brutalist, POPEYE) ➜ Visual Planner ➜ pure EditorialSpec generation (model-agnostic logic).
3. Swappable Model Adapters: Seamlessly routes the same EditorialSpec to GPT Image, Flux.1, or Ideogram 2.0 adapters, enabling instant model switching while preserving 100% creative direction.

master_skills.description_en: Defines 10 custom 16:9 presentation specs, compulsory 2-stage deck planning gate, Slidev exporters, and beautiful-article editorial engine.
sub_modules_zh: 兩階段簡報規劃門禁 (2-Stage Deck Plan Gate): 嚴禁直接做簡報！必須先產出 presentation_plan.md (含頁數、大標小標、內文大意、視覺選型、紅線自查)，經確認後才輸出簡報。

簡報 6 大紅線原則: (1) 100% 完整呈現原文 (2) 不改變圖片比例 (3) 嚴禁文字圖片重疊貼邊 (4) 圖片直觀對應 (5) 圖片符合風格 (6) 每頁皆須圖文並茂且排版多樣不重複。

editorial-vision-studio 視覺總監: 具備 10 大雜誌封面/海報級 AI 提示詞編譯大腦，為簡報自動構思絕不違和的高質感配圖 Prompt。
sub_modules_en: 2-Stage Deck Plan Gate: Mandatory 2-stage execution! Writes presentation_plan.md (slides count, headers, subtext, visual choice, redline check) for user approval before writing slides code.

10 Artistic 16:9 Presentation Specs: Neon Architecture (10:1 scaling), Apple 3D Mockup, Sculpture Pop, Kinfolk (Mincho Serif), Swiss New Economy (STRICT NO MARKDOWN), Living Artifact, Gentle Flat, Slidev.
3 Red-Line Presentation Rules: (1) 100% full content fidelity, (2) preserve image aspect ratios, (3) zero text-image overlaps or border clipping.
beautiful-article Editorial Engine: Single-page web publication refactoring with 10 retention models and 11 master themes.

principles.title_zh: 📝 簡報製作 Master Prompt 提示詞範例 (Standard Master Prompt)
principles.title_en: 📝 Standard Master Prompt Template for Presentation Creation
principles.desc_zh: 我要在這個對話進行「(......簡報製作任務)」。請以("......檔案路徑")的內容為材料，採取並嚴格遵守("......簡報風格")的規則和風格，製作 16:9 /(或)A4 Slidev， HTML / (或)可編輯的 ppt 簡報。 請先不要直接執行簡報的製作，而是先寫出「簡報規劃的計畫書」，計畫書中要寫出：總共會有幾頁、每一頁的「大標題」內容、「小標題」內容、大致的內文要寫什麼、需不需要使用 ai 圖片生成，或是可以去網路上搜尋下載圖片。 【6個紅線 (嚴格遵守)】 1. 簡報請完整呈現「(某某檔案)」的完美內容。撰寫內容時請不要克制，頁數不用省、內文也可以寫多一點。並且不要有曲解、誇大其辭、用詞太過激昂的情況。 2. 圖片請不要調整原有的圖片比例，只允許對圖片進行「裁切」、「縮小」、「放大」。 3. 無論是大標題小標題或內文、圖片，請都不要與其他文字或圖片有重疊，也不要有貼到畫面過於邊緣的地方(但若圖片是打算沒有空白縫隙的貼緊邊緣，則沒有此限制)。 4. 保證網路搜尋或自行生成的圖片絕對都要與當前簡報頁面的內容直接高度相關，嚴禁使用抽象隱喻、幾何符號或高深意象圖，必須選用一眼就能直觀看懂、與簡報內文精準對應的具體實物或情境圖片。 5. 保證網路搜尋或生成的圖片絕對都要符合當前選擇的整體簡報風格，嚴禁出現與整體簡報風格相比顯得突兀或視覺風格斷層的圖片。 6. 簡報的每一頁都必須同時包含「圖片」與「文字」（圖文並茂），且每一頁的視覺佈局與結構必須變化多元，嚴禁連續多頁重複使用完全相同的範本或視覺排版結構。
principles.desc_en:
I would like to conduct a "(...Presentation Deck Task)". Using the material from ("...File Path"), adopt and strictly follow the rules and style of ("...Presentation Style") to produce 16:9 /(or)A4 Slidev, HTML / (or) editable ppt slides.

DO NOT execute slide deck creation directly! You MUST first write a "Presentation Plan Document" outlining: total slide count, main header, subheader, key body text summary, and whether AI image generation or online image download is required.

【6 RED-LINE RULES (STRICT)】

1. Preserve 100% full text fidelity of "(...Source File)". Do not distort, exaggerate, or use overly aggressive phrasing.
2. Never distort image aspect ratios. Only crop, shrink, or enlarge.
3. Zero text/image overlaps and zero unintended edge clipping. Keep generous margin buffers (except for full-bleed images intended to fit edge-to-edge without gaps).
4. All searched or generated images MUST be directly, intuitively relevant to the current slide's topic. Pure abstract metaphors or vague geometric graphics are strictly forbidden; use easily understandable, explicit real-world or situational imagery.
5. All searched or generated images MUST strictly match the chosen presentation visual style. Images that clash visually or break style consistency are strictly forbidden.
6. Every single slide MUST contain both images and text (rich text-image pairing). Slide layout structures MUST vary dynamically across pages; repeating identical layout templates across multiple consecutive slides is strictly forbidden.

principles.title_zh: 📰 beautiful-article 10 大文章保留率模型與 11 大排版主題
principles.title_en: 📰 beautiful-article 10 Article Retention Models & 11 Master Themes
principles.desc_zh:
beautiful-article 是將原始素材（URL/PDF/DOCX/筆記）重構並排版為高品質單頁網頁文章的編輯引擎：
1. 10 大文章保留率模型：支援深度長文 (Longform 100%)、實作教學 (Tutorial 90%)、完整報告 (Report 80%)、摘要簡報 (Briefing 50%) 到視覺文章 (Visual Essay 40%)，可依閱讀目的嚴格精準控制資訊密度。
2. 11 大大師排版主題 (Theme Profiles)：涵蓋 Tufte (學術邊註風格)、Bodoni (經典時尚刊物)、Vignelli (網格系統)、Press (新聞編輯)、Knuth (數學排版) 等 11 種出版物等級的字體與版面氣質。
3. Reacticle 語意組件與 3:4 書籍封面：採用 Hero / Lead / Quote / Callout / Raw 語意層與 3:4 書本風格封面，搭配自動生成 TOC 目錄，打造離線亦可完美閱讀與分享的排版作品。
principles.desc_en:
beautiful-article converts raw documents (URL/PDF/DOCX/notes) into publication-grade single-file HTML web articles:
1. 10 Article Retention Models: Supports Longform (100%), Tutorial (90%), Full Report (80%), Briefing (50%), and Visual Essay (40%) to control information density precisely.
2. 11 Master Theme Profiles: Includes Tufte (academic marginalia), Bodoni (classic editorial), Vignelli (grid system), Press (news editorial), and Knuth (math publishing).
3. Reacticle Component Protocol & 3:4 Cover: Uses prose-first semantic components (Hero, Lead, Quote, Callout, Raw layer) with a 3:4 book cover and auto TOC for offline reading and sharing.

        </defs>

        <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#f5f5f5"/>
        <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="url(#dots)" opacity="0.55"/>

        <!-- Transitions (drawn first) -->

<svg viewBox="0 0 1000 480" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-labelledby="venn-title venn-desc">
      <title id="venn-title">Good design · Desirable × Feasible × Viable</title>
      <desc id="venn-desc">Venn diagram showing desirable, feasible, and viable product qualities intersecting at shippable.</desc>
        <defs><style>*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0;} :root {
      --color-paper:   #f5f5f5;
      --color-ink:     #2d3142;
      --color-muted:   #4f5d75;
      --color-accent:  #eb6c36;
      --font-sans:     'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif;
      --font-serif:    'Instrument Serif', serif;
      --font-mono:     'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;} svg { font-family: var(--font-sans); background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); display:block; width:100%; height:auto; } svg { font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--color-muted); display:block; width:100%; height:auto; } svg { font-family: var(--font-serif); color: var(--color-ink); display:block; width:100%; height:auto; } svg { width: 100%; min-width: 900px; display: block;} svg text { user-select: none; } </style>
          <!-- Chained clips isolate the all-three intersection: clip to Desirable, then to Feasible, then fill via the third circle. -->
          <clipPath id="clip-desirable">
            <circle cx="500" cy="180" r="140"/>
          </clipPath>
          <clipPath id="clip-feasible">
            <circle cx="428" cy="320" r="140"/>
          </clipPath>
        </defs>

        <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#f5f5f5"/>

        <!-- Three set circles (stroke + very-low-opacity tint; tints compound in overlaps) -->
        <!-- Desirable — top, ink -->
        <circle cx="500" cy="180" r="140" fill="rgba(45,49,66,0.04)" stroke="#2d3142" stroke-width="1"/>
        <!-- Feasible — bottom-left, muted -->
        <circle cx="428" cy="320" r="140" fill="rgba(79,93,117,0.05)" stroke="#4f5d75" stroke-width="1"/>
        <!-- Viable — bottom-right, soft -->
        <circle cx="572" cy="320" r="140" fill="rgba(122,131,153,0.05)" stroke="#7a8399" stroke-width="1"/>

        <!-- Focal: solid-ink triple intersection (dark fill for white text to read against) -->
        <g clip-path="url(#clip-desirable)">
          <g clip-path="url(#clip-feasible)">
            <circle cx="572" cy="320" r="140" fill="#2d3142"/>
          </g>
        </g>

        <!-- Set labels — positioned INSIDE each circle's non-overlapping lobe, so the diagram reads like a classic Venn -->
        <!-- Desirable — top lobe (centered inside top of Desirable circle) -->
        <text x="500" y="96" fill="#2d3142" font-size="14" font-weight="600" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif" text-anchor="middle">Desirable</text>
        <text x="500" y="112" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="9" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="0.14em">PEOPLE WANT IT</text>

        <!-- Feasible — bottom-left lobe -->
        <text x="340" y="386" fill="#2d3142" font-size="14" font-weight="600" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif" text-anchor="middle">Feasible</text>
        <text x="340" y="402" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="9" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="0.14em">WE CAN BUILD IT</text>

        <!-- Viable — bottom-right lobe -->
        <text x="660" y="386" fill="#2d3142" font-size="14" font-weight="600" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif" text-anchor="middle">Viable</text>
        <text x="660" y="402" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="9" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="0.14em">BUSINESS SUSTAINS</text>

        <!-- Focal label: white text on the dark intersection -->
        <text x="500" y="268" fill="#ffffff" font-size="14" font-weight="600" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif" text-anchor="middle">Shippable</text>
        <text x="500" y="284" fill="rgba(245,245,245,0.75)" font-size="9" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="0.14em">THE SWEET SPOT</text>
      </svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 1000 660" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-labelledby="quadrant-consultant-title quadrant-consultant-desc">
        <title id="quadrant-consultant-title">Workplace 2030 · Remote × AI automation</title>
        <desc id="quadrant-consultant-desc">Scenario matrix showing four workplace futures across remote-to-in-person and human-to-AI axes, with agent teams as the headline bet.</desc>
        <defs><style>:root {
      --color-paper:   #f5f5f5;
      --color-paper-2: #ececec;
      --color-ink:     #2d3142;
      --color-muted:   #4f5d75;
      --color-soft:    #7a8399;
      --color-rule:    rgba(45,49,66,0.12);
      --color-accent:  #eb6c36;
      --font-sans:     'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif;
      --font-serif:    'Instrument Serif', serif;
      --font-mono:     'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;} :root { font-family: var(--font-sans); background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); } .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto;} .header { margin-bottom: 2.5rem;} .header-eyebrow { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;} :root { font-family: var(--font-serif); } :root { color: var(--color-muted); } svg  { display: block;  } .cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr 0.9fr; gap: 1rem; margin-top: 1.5rem;} @media (max-width: 820px) { .cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr;} .card { background: #fff; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); padding: 1.25rem;} .card .eyebrow { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.5rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted); margin-bottom: 0.5rem;} .card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; margin-bottom: 0.875rem; padding-bottom: 0.875rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(45,49,66,0.08);} .card-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%;} .card-dot.ink { background: var(--color-ink);} .card-dot.muted { background: var(--color-muted);} .card-dot.coral { background: var(--color-accent);} .card h3 { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600;} .card p, .card ul { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.55; list-style: none;} .card li { margin-bottom: 0.3rem; padding-left: 0.875rem; position: relative;} .card li::before { content: '—'; position: absolute; left: 0; color: rgba(45,49,66,0.25); font-size: 0.75rem;} .footer { margin-top: 2rem; padding-top: 1.5rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(45,49,66,0.10); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--color-soft); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem;}</style>
          <!-- Double-ended axis markers -->
          <marker id="axis-end" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="7" refX="8" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
            <polygon points="0 0, 9 3.5, 0 7" fill="#2d3142"/>
          </marker>
          <marker id="axis-start" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="7" refX="1" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
            <polygon points="9 0, 0 3.5, 9 7" fill="#2d3142"/>
          </marker>
        </defs>

        <!-- Clean paper background, no dot pattern -->
        <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#f5f5f5"/>

        <!-- Focal quadrant tint (TR) — coral at 3% -->
        <rect x="500" y="80" width="400" height="220" fill="rgba(235,108,54,0.04)"/>

        <!-- Scenario cells — store treatment with hairline rule, slightly varied -->
        <!-- TL: Distributed humans -->
        <rect x="140" y="120" width="300" height="160" rx="6" fill="rgba(45,49,66,0.04)" stroke="rgba(79,93,117,0.28)" stroke-width="1"/>
        <text x="156" y="144" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="8" font-weight="500" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" letter-spacing="0.18em">01 · REMOTE / HUMAN</text>
        <text x="156" y="180" fill="#2d3142" font-size="16" font-weight="600" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">Distributed humans</text>
        <text x="156" y="216" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="11" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">Async-first, global hiring,</text>
        <text x="156" y="232" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="11" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">Slack-heavy. Human-centric</text>
        <text x="156" y="248" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="11" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">workflows, low AI leverage.</text>

        <!-- TR: Agent teams (FOCAL) -->
        <rect x="560" y="120" width="300" height="160" rx="6" fill="rgba(235,108,54,0.06)" stroke="#eb6c36" stroke-width="1.2"/>
        <text x="576" y="144" fill="#eb6c36" font-size="8" font-weight="600" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" letter-spacing="0.18em">02 · REMOTE / AI</text>
        <text x="576" y="180" fill="#2d3142" font-size="16" font-weight="600" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">Agent teams <tspan fill="#eb6c36" font-size="13">●</tspan></text>
        <text x="576" y="216" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="11" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">Humans orchestrate; AI</text>
        <text x="576" y="232" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="11" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">handles the routine layer.</text>
        <text x="576" y="248" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="11" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">Small, high-leverage teams.</text>

        <!-- BL: Office classic -->
        <rect x="140" y="320" width="300" height="160" rx="6" fill="rgba(45,49,66,0.04)" stroke="rgba(79,93,117,0.28)" stroke-width="1"/>
        <text x="156" y="344" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="8" font-weight="500" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" letter-spacing="0.18em">03 · IN-PERSON / HUMAN</text>
        <text x="156" y="380" fill="#2d3142" font-size="16" font-weight="600" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">Office classic</text>
        <text x="156" y="416" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="11" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">Return-to-office mandates,</text>
        <text x="156" y="432" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="11" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">manual work. Techlash</text>
        <text x="156" y="448" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="11" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">prolongs the status quo.</text>

        <!-- BR: In-person + AI -->
        <rect x="560" y="320" width="300" height="160" rx="6" fill="rgba(45,49,66,0.04)" stroke="rgba(79,93,117,0.28)" stroke-width="1"/>
        <text x="576" y="344" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="8" font-weight="500" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" letter-spacing="0.18em">04 · IN-PERSON / AI</text>
        <text x="576" y="380" fill="#2d3142" font-size="16" font-weight="600" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">In-person + AI</text>
        <text x="576" y="416" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="11" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">Smart offices, AI-augmented</text>
        <text x="576" y="432" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="11" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">staff. Physical presence is</text>
        <text x="576" y="448" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="11" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">the moat, AI is the lever.</text>

        <!-- Axis cross — double-ended; horizontal shortened so the labels flank the tips cleanly -->
        <line x1="200" y1="300" x2="800" y2="300"
              stroke="#2d3142" stroke-width="1.2"
              marker-start="url(#axis-start)" marker-end="url(#axis-end)"/>
        <line x1="500" y1="60" x2="500" y2="540"
              stroke="#2d3142" stroke-width="1.2"
              marker-start="url(#axis-start)" marker-end="url(#axis-end)"/>

        <text x="500" y="48" fill="#2d3142" font-size="9" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="0.18em">REMOTE</text>

        <text x="500" y="560" fill="#2d3142" font-size="9" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="0.18em">IN-PERSON</text>

        <text x="188" y="300" fill="#2d3142" font-size="9" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="middle" letter-spacing="0.18em">HUMAN</text>

        <text x="812" y="300" fill="#2d3142" font-size="9" font-family="'Geist Mono', monospace" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="middle" letter-spacing="0.18em">AI</text>

        <!-- Legend — horizontal strip, placed BELOW the bottom axis labels (y=560/576) -->
        <line x1="40" y1="604" x2="960" y2="604" stroke="rgba(45,49,66,0.10)" stroke-width="0.8"/>
        <rect x="40" y="616" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="rgba(235,108,54,0.06)" stroke="#eb6c36" stroke-width="1"/>
        <text x="64" y="628" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="8.5" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">Headline bet</text>
        <rect x="160" y="616" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="rgba(45,49,66,0.04)" stroke="rgba(79,93,117,0.28)" stroke-width="1"/>
        <text x="184" y="628" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="8.5" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif">Candidate future</text>
        <text x="304" y="628" fill="#4f5d75" font-size="8.5" font-family="'Geist', sans-serif" font-style="italic">Every cell is named. The axes carry the range; the coral quadrant carries the commitment.</text>
      </svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 1040 680" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-labelledby="loop-title loop-desc">
      <title id="loop-title">The self-improving loop</title>
      <desc id="loop-desc">Six stations flow clockwise from Capture through Learn and back to Capture. Each station writes shared state into one central memory hub, with Decide highlighted as the human approval gate.</desc>
      <defs><style>:root {
      --paper: #f5f5f5; --ink: #2d3142; --muted: #4f5d75; --soft: #7a8399;
      --accent: #eb6c36; --accent-tint: rgba(235,108,54,0.08); --link: #2e5aa8;
      --sans: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; --serif: 'Instrument Serif', serif;
      --mono: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;} :root { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--sans); } :root { color: var(--muted); font: 500 0.66rem var(--mono); } :root { color: var(--ink); font: 400 clamp(1.5rem, 2.4vw + 0.75rem, 2rem)/1.15 var(--serif); } svg  { display: block;  } .ring { fill: none; stroke: var(--muted); stroke-width: 1.2;} .spoke { fill: none; stroke: var(--soft); stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 5 4;} .station { fill: var(--paper); stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 1;} .station.focal { fill: var(--accent-tint); stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 1.2;} .hub { fill: var(--ink);} .node-name { fill: var(--ink); font: 600 12px var(--sans); text-anchor: middle;} .focal-name { fill: var(--accent);} .sublabel { fill: var(--soft); font: 400 8px var(--mono); text-anchor: middle;} .hub-name { fill: var(--paper); font: 600 16px var(--sans); text-anchor: middle;} .hub-sub { fill: var(--paper); opacity: 0.72; font: 400 8px var(--mono); text-anchor: middle;} .arrow-label { fill: var(--soft); font: 400 8px var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-anchor: middle;}</style>
        <pattern id="dots" width="22" height="22" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><circle cx="1" cy="1" r="0.9" fill="rgba(45,49,66,0.10)"/></pattern>
        <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="6" refX="7" refY="3" orient="auto"><polygon points="0 0, 8 3, 0 6" fill="#4f5d75"/></marker>
        <marker id="arrow-accent" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="6" refX="7" refY="3" orient="auto"><polygon points="0 0, 8 3, 0 6" fill="#eb6c36"/></marker>
        <marker id="arrow-link" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="6" refX="7" refY="3" orient="auto"><polygon points="0 0, 8 3, 0 6" fill="#2e5aa8"/></marker>
        <marker id="arrow-soft" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="6" refX="7" refY="3" orient="auto"><polygon points="0 0, 8 3, 0 6" fill="#7a8399"/></marker>
      </defs>
      <rect width="1040" height="680" fill="#f5f5f5"/>
      <rect width="1040" height="680" fill="url(#dots)" opacity="0.55"/>

      <!-- Solid clockwise ring: six arcs on the same r=240 station circle. -->
      <path class="ring" d="M600 113.726 A240 240 0 0 1 704.969 187.073" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
      <path class="ring" d="M743.285 252 A240 240 0 0 1 743.722 426.882" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
      <path class="ring" d="M705.731 492 A240 240 0 0 1 601.130 565.871" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
      <path class="ring" d="M440 566.274 A240 240 0 0 1 335.031 492.927" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
      <path class="ring" d="M296.715 428 A240 240 0 0 1 296.278 253.118" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
      <path class="ring" d="M334.269 188 A240 240 0 0 1 438.870 114.129" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>

      <!-- Dashed write-backs: station inner edge to 6px before the hub stroke. -->
      <path class="spoke" d="M520 132 V280" marker-end="url(#arrow-soft)"/>
      <path class="spoke" d="M672 252 L616 284" marker-end="url(#arrow-soft)"/>
      <path class="spoke" d="M672 428 L616 396" marker-end="url(#arrow-soft)"/>
      <path class="spoke" d="M520 548 V400" marker-end="url(#arrow-soft)"/>
      <path class="spoke" d="M368 428 L424 396" marker-end="url(#arrow-soft)"/>
      <path class="spoke" d="M368 252 L424 284" marker-end="url(#arrow-soft)"/>

      <!-- Curated spoke labels sit beside the line with an 8px visible gap. -->
      <rect x="532" y="200" width="48" height="16" rx="4" fill="#f5f5f5"/>
      <text x="556" y="212" class="arrow-label">SIGNALS</text>
      <rect x="460" y="464" width="52" height="16" rx="4" fill="#f5f5f5"/>
      <text x="486" y="476" class="arrow-label">OUTCOMES</text>

      <!-- Stations -->
      <rect class="station" x="440" y="68" width="160" height="64" rx="6"/>
      <text x="520" y="96" class="node-name">Capture</text><text x="520" y="116" class="sublabel">signals in / intake</text>

      <rect class="station" x="648" y="188" width="160" height="64" rx="6"/>
      <text x="728" y="216" class="node-name">Research</text><text x="728" y="236" class="sublabel">evidence pulled</text>

      <rect class="station focal" x="648" y="428" width="160" height="64" rx="6"/>
      <text x="728" y="456" class="node-name focal-name">Decide</text><text x="728" y="476" class="sublabel">human approves</text>

      <rect class="station" x="440" y="548" width="160" height="64" rx="6"/>
      <text x="520" y="576" class="node-name">Act</text><text x="520" y="596" class="sublabel">work ships</text>

      <rect class="station" x="232" y="428" width="160" height="64" rx="6"/>
      <text x="312" y="456" class="node-name">Measure</text><text x="312" y="476" class="sublabel">outcomes logged</text>

      <rect class="station" x="232" y="188" width="160" height="64" rx="6"/>
      <text x="312" y="216" class="node-name">Learn</text><text x="312" y="236" class="sublabel">playbook updated</text>

      <!-- The one shared-state hub. -->
      <rect class="hub" x="420" y="288" width="200" height="104" rx="8"/>

    </svg>
